source_text: These results, published in The Lancet, provided causal evidence linking foreskin removal to lower HIV transmission via reduced viral entry during penile-vaginal intercourse, prompting the World Health Organization (WHO) and Joint United Nations Programme on HIV/AIDS (UNAIDS) to issue a joint policy in March 2007 recommending VMMC scale-up as part of combination HIV prevention in generalized epidemics, particularly in sub-Saharan Africa where circumcision prevalence was low (under 20% in many areas) despite HIV rates exceeding 10%. [72]
